ns2:course.label: Meat Science
ns2:course.description: Fundamental biological principles that influence composition, processing, preservation, and quality of meat and meat products. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ANSC 221, IB 100, or equivalent, and CHEM 102.
